meta.title: space props evenly along a curve
meta.description: Two primitives cover the whole road-and-lamp-posts shape: `shape/path-meander` is a curve SOURCE — an open path that wanders off a straight line by noise and is re-evened by arc length, needing no cloud to start from — and `place/along-curve` resamples it and turns every new point to face the way the curve goes, so a `spacing` of 6 means a post every 6 world units however long the road turns out to be. The points `place/along-curve` emits are new ones carrying `P`, `tangent`, `curveU` and `rot`, plus every attribute the curve carried on its PRIMITIVES — a post inherits the road it stands on; when the curve's own POINTS matter instead, `write/orient-along-path` orients them in place. Note what varies: the meander carries its noise seed inside a field spec, so `variant` is its only re-roll.
